Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL4611 (Complement C1r subcomponent). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4611, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
